name: @rca/api
description: Cloudflare Worker API: accounts, sessions, profiles and activity digests. Production uses Workers, D1 and R2; local development simulates retained-file paths locally.

scripts.e2e:api: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e-state && mkdir -p ../web/dist && (test -f .dev.vars || cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars) && wrangler d1 migrations apply rca --local --config wrangler.local.toml --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state && wrangler dev --config wrangler.local.toml --port 8787 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state --var APP_URL:http://localhost:4319 --show-interactive-dev-session=false
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply rca --local --config wrangler.local.toml
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/check-deploy-config.mjs --bootstrap && wrangler d1 migrations apply rca --remote
